name: reconcile-writes-back-the-snapshot
code: EventOutbox.flush: queue.replace(pending minus delivered) instead of queue.reconcile(...)

edits.find: disk' = IF durable THEN Reconciled(disk, delivered[f], retried[f]) ELSE disk
edits.replace: disk' = IF durable THEN Reconciled(pending[f], delivered[f], retried[f]) ELSE disk

name: drain-loop-ends-unconditionally
code: EventOutbox.scheduleFlush: drainState.set(IDLE) instead of while (!drainState.compareAndSet(DRAINING, IDLE))

name: no-drain-again
code: EventOutbox.scheduleFlush: the DRAINING branch returns without setting DRAIN_AGAIN

name: fix-read-the-id-per-row
code: EventOutbox.flush: call currentClientId() inside the loop, per row, instead of once before it

edits.find:
stale == e.cid # NoId /\ snapId[f] # NoId /\ e.cid # snapId[f]
        row == IF e.cid = NoId /\ snapId[f] # NoId THEN [e EXCEPT !.cid = snapId[f]] ELSE e
edits.replace:
stale == e.cid # NoId /\ id # NoId /\ e.cid # id
        row == IF e.cid = NoId /\ id # NoId THEN [e EXCEPT !.cid = id] ELSE e
